title: Nice looking, but slippery
text: Nice looking, but slippery. I'm happy with the design of this rug. I bought two runners from 2 different companies. They are vastly different. This one arrived rolled up and still hasn't flattened. It isn't quite "rectangular" so it doesn't lay against my walls evenly, it's like it was cut wrong... and it is very, very thin. The other rug must weight 3 times what this one does, same exact size... and this one, twice the price. Go figure.

product_metadata.title: Ottomanson Moroccan Trellis Design 5X7 Area Rug, 63" W x 83" L, Gray/Ivory
features: Area Rug with durable polypropylene pile and jute backing, 5'3"X6'11" - (63" X 83").
Kids and pets friendly. Great for high traffic areas.
This rug is resistant to stain, fade, and wear and does not shed
PLEASE NOTE: Rotate and vacuum your rug periodically. Spot clean if needed. Rugs may have temporary creases upon arrival due to packaging, give some time to flatten and settle.
description: This contemporary design boho area rug features a power loomed polypropylene soft profile pile which is durable for a long lasting quality. Inspired by contemporary abstract patterns with modern colors. This rug makes any home complete with style and elegance.
